title: Fix Reveal background + audio reliability, and update teddy/bears visuals with transparent assets

requirements.summary: Ensure Phase 2 (Reveal) shows the uploaded background image (photo4.jpg) clearly using the correct existing asset path and unobscuring overlay treatment.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking the Phase 1 button, the Reveal view displays the background image (photo4.jpg) behind the overlay and content on both mobile and desktop.
The background image request returns HTTP 200 in the browser network panel and is not blocked by an incorrect path.
The background image is not visually obscured by overlays; the overlay (if present) still allows the background to be recognizable.

file_operations.description: Fix Reveal background rendering by referencing the correct static asset URL for photo4.jpg (ensuring it resolves to HTTP 200) and adjust overlay opacity/blur so the background remains clearly recognizable behind content.
Add/ensure the uploaded background image is available as a static public asset at frontend/public/assets/photo4.jpg so the Reveal background request resolves with HTTP 200.

requirements.summary: Make Phase 2 (Reveal) audio reliably load and start on button click, with a visible manual play fallback when autoplay is blocked, while preserving looping and existing mute/play toggle behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: On button click, the app attempts to play the audio and sets the UI state to reflect playback when successful.
If autoplay is blocked, a visible play control appears and successfully starts playback on user interaction.
The audio file request returns HTTP 200 in the browser network panel (no 404/failed load due to filename/path issues).
Audio continues looping as intended, and the existing mute/play toggle continues to work after playback starts.

file_operations.description: Harden audio initialization + playback: ensure the audio src matches the public asset path, set loop, attach play/pause/error listeners to keep UI state accurate, attempt playback on Phase 1 button click, and keep the manual play fallback visible and functional when autoplay is blocked.

file_operations.path: frontend/public/assets/audio/KAUN TUJHE Lyrical Video _ Armaan Malik _ M.S. DHONI -THE UNTOLD STORY _ T-Series(M4A_128K).m4a
file_operations.description: Add/ensure the uploaded romantic song is available as a static public asset at the exact path used by the app so the request resolves with HTTP 200.

requirements.summary: Update Phase 2 visuals to use a transparent hugging-bears asset and refine glassmorphism so both the image and message remain semi-transparent but readable over the photo background without altering message text.
acceptanceCriteria: The hugging-bears visual uses a transparent image format (PNG/WebP with alpha) so the background is visible around/through it.
The hugging-bears image is displayed with correct sizing and is not stretched or cropped unexpectedly on common mobile widths.
The message card remains glassmorphism-style (semi-transparent with blur) and the text remains clearly readable against the background image.
No user-provided message text characters/emojis/punctuation are modified.

file_operations.description: Swap Reveal hugging-bears image to the transparent alpha asset and adjust sizing/container classes for mobile-friendly containment; tune glassmorphism card transparency/blur/contrast for readability while preserving the message text exactly (no character changes).
Add the generated transparent (alpha) hugging-bears image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hugging-bears-transparent.dim_1400x900.png and wire it in the Reveal view.

requirements.summary: Replace Phase 1 hero teddy image with a single teddy holding a heart reading "i love you", keeping it crisp, centered, and mobile-friendly while preserving the exact heading and button text.
acceptanceCriteria: Phase 1 continues to show the heading text exactly "Happy Hug Day My Love" and the button text exactly "Hug me! Pop me! 🧸".
The hero image depicts a single teddy bear holding a heart with "i love you" written on it.
The hero image renders at the existing hero placement without distortion and remains mobile-friendly.

file_operations.description: Update Phase 1 hero image source to the new teddy-heart illustration asset and ensure the existing hero container remains centered, crisp, and uses object-contain to prevent distortion; keep heading/button strings exactly unchanged.
Add the generated hero image at frontend/public/assets/generated/teddy-hero-heart-ily.dim_1400x900.png and wire it into the Phase 1 hero slot.
